people.imagined: Dusk at the graves, the chorus seated in rows. He has just heard a cough and tilts his head to find it, deciding who will be struck from the roll. The old scar on his throat catches the last light.
people.subject: The moment: at dusk among grave mounds, he tilts his head sharply to the left, listening for a cough in the chorus, and is about to decide something. Face, most important: a pale raised cord of scar runs all the way around his throat like a thin necklace, plainly visible above the collar, puckered where it crosses the windpipe. A long, calm, bony face of forty; skin the colour of tallow; narrow dark eyes with the lids half lowered; thin straight eyebrows; a long nose; a mouth set in a small patient line. Hair: black with a few grey threads, long, combed back and held low by a single bone hairpin. Body: tall and narrow, straight-backed, chin lifted to listen. Clothing: layered mourning silk of undyed white and ash-grey, three crossed collars cut low enough to show the scar, wide sleeves that fall in long folds, a translucent black gauze over-robe drifting like smoke; the collar borders are embroidered in dull silver with withered lotus and curls of grave-incense; an ash-grey sash hung with a small dark resentment-jade seal and tassels. Hands: one long pale hand raised to cup behind his left ear, nails clean. Power: a faint green-teal damp haze gathers at his shoulder and a few pale motes drift upward, calm and restrained. Background: blurred rows of seated singers in white, low earth mounds, thin mist between them. Light: the last amber dusk-light from the upper left turning to cool spirit-light, a soft silver rim along his cheekbone and the scar. Expression: devout, calm, with a touch of arbitrary coldness in the set of the mouth.

people.imagined: She kneels at a river grave with a stick of chalk, finishing a seal line, and looks up as though she has heard someone count coins. The silver ring swings on its string.
people.subject: The moment: kneeling at a river grave, she looks up mid-line from a seal she is chalking, shrewd and a little amused, as if she has heard someone counting money. Face, most important: her palms and fingers are ground white with chalk dust, deep in every line, held up in front of her, and a single plain silver ring hangs on a string at her neck, catching the light and swinging. A heart-shaped face of thirty; clear tan skin; sharp, quick brown eyes under neat arched brows; a small straight nose; full lips with one corner lifted. Hair: black, long, half coiled low at the nape and held by a single bone hairpin, a few loose strands drifting. Body: slim, compact, leaning forward on one knee. Clothing: layered mourning silk in undyed white and ash-grey with two crossed collars, the wide sleeves tied back with white cord above the elbow so the tanned, lightly freckled forearms are bare; a thin black gauze over-robe pooled on the ground around her; collar borders embroidered in dull silver with withered lotus; an ash-grey sash with a small dark resentment-jade seal; chalk smears on the hem. Hands: a stub of white chalk pinched between thumb and finger. Power: a faint pale metallic gleam in the chalk dust, a few silver-white motes lifting from the seal line. Background: blurred green riverbank, a mossy grave stone, drifting mist. Light: cool silvery moon-pale light from the upper left, soft glowing rim light on her hair. Expression: a shrewd, slightly amused look with a raised brow, one corner of the mouth lifted, eyes quick.

people.imagined: A ridge hunter's boy stands at a cave mouth with a sack of millet at his feet, selling a widow a dead man's name. In the dim light his eyes have gone white. He is making the name up and hopes his face does not show it.
people.subject: The moment: standing at the mouth of a dark cave in lamplight, he has just told a lie to the viewer and holds still so his face will not betray it. Face, most important: his eyes are milk-white, pale and clouded, with only the pupil dots showing, plainly strange and faintly luminous. A thin sixteen-year-old face; sun-brown skin with a few spots of acne on the cheek; a broad flat nose; chapped lips pressed together; thick uneven eyebrows. Around his neck hangs a necklace of about a dozen yellowed animal teeth on a thong, with three bare knots where teeth were sold. Hair: coarse black, long enough to be gathered and held by a single bone hairpin, tufts escaping. Body: wiry, hunched slightly, shoulders raised. Clothing: simple, clean mourning silk of undyed white with a crossed collar and an ash-grey sash, wide sleeves a little short for his growing arms, a thin black gauze scarf at the shoulders, and a trim of dull silver withered-lotus embroidery at the collar; a modest, graceful outer-disciple robe. Hands: one hand holds up a single tooth of the necklace between finger and thumb, knuckles chapped, nails bitten. Power: a faint violet-black shimmer curls at the edge of his shoulders, with a few dark motes. Background: the black mouth of a cave with a single guttering lantern, mist crawling from it. Light: weak yellow lamplight from lower left, cold blue spirit-glow in the shadows, his white eyes shining like wet pearls. Expression: a half-smile held a moment too long, wide still eyes, a stiff face working not to betray itself.

people.imagined: Dawn on the pavilion's stone steps. She is sweeping, singing off-key on purpose, loudly, so that the dead will know her voice.
people.subject: The moment: sweeping stone steps at dawn, she throws back her head and sings loudly, deliberately off-key, mouth open and eyes shut, so that the dead will know her voice. Face, most important: a thin white fishhook scar cuts through her left eyebrow, splitting it in two, easy to see. A round, freckled, sunburnt sixteen-year-old face, broad cheeks, a wide mouth with a gap between the front teeth, small dark eyes crinkled with a grin. Hair: wavy brown, long, tied up in a loose knot and held by a single bone hairpin, damp wisps stuck to her neck. Body: sturdy and square, big hands. Clothing: the plainest graceful silk of an outer disciple: undyed white mourning robe with two crossed collars and short wide sleeves, a pale ash-grey gauze over-layer, dull silver withered-lotus stitching at the collar, a white sash with a small dark jade bead; clean and bright. Hands: a straw broom with twigs bound in red thread held upright against her shoulder. Power: a faint teal damp glimmer shimmers on her hair and a few drops of light float from her open mouth. Background: pale stone steps falling away behind her, a few grave mounds, mist on a distant river, pearl-grey gulls turning. Light: pink-gold dawn glowing through the mist from the upper left, a luminous soft rim along her cheek. Feet bare and grey-wet on the stone, a pale line on one ankle where a net-cord chafed. Expression: an open mouth in loud song, eyes shut and chin lifted, a stubborn, joyful face.

people.imagined: Late in the day in the copy room, draught in the shutters. His hair has come undone again. He stands at the door to hold someone talking, smiling too evenly.
people.subject: The moment: standing at a copy-room door in the afternoon draught, he is making conversation to hold someone back, one hand lifted, smiling too evenly. Face, most important: a thin reddish bamboo ruling-stick, a hand long and sharpened at the tip, is tucked behind his right ear and stands out plainly beside his head, and his hair, neat in the morning, has come half undone and stands in wisps. A narrow, careful, pleasant face of twenty-four; fair skin with ink on the cheek; light brown eyes; thin neat brows; a small straight nose; a smile that does not reach the eyes. Hair: dark brown, parted in the centre, long and loose over the ears, held at the back by a single bone hairpin that has slipped. Body: slight, slightly stooped from desk work. Clothing: fine white and ash-grey mourning silk with three crossed collars, narrow sleeves, a padded quilted lining showing at the neck, a translucent black gauze over-robe lifting in the draught, dull silver withered-lotus and incense-curl embroidery on the borders, a sash with a small dark resentment-jade seal. Hands: an inked brush held like a pointer, fingernails neatly pared and inky. Power: a faint pale green glow at the shoulder, a few motes caught in the draught. Background: blurred shelves of bound books, a paper window, a loose sheet of paper lifting. Light: cool grey spirit-light from the left with a soft silver rim. Expression: a smile held too evenly, tense eyes, a faintly strained brow, stiff cheeks.

people.imagined: In the bamboo grove she sits on a cut cane, restless, drumming her fingers on a flute she cannot play through. She has just won an argument that the grove counts as the Pavilion.
people.subject: The moment: seated on a cut bamboo cane in the grove, she drums her fingers on a flute she cannot play through, bored and pleased with herself after winning an argument that the grove counts as the Pavilion. Face, most important: a thin pale scar from a bamboo splinter runs down the centre of her lower lip, silvery and clearly visible, and her fingers blur mid-drum on the flute. A narrow, pointed face of seventeen, light brown, with large restless dark eyes that glance sideways, thin brows, a small upturned nose and a quick sly smile. Hair: black, long, half gathered into two short high tails tied with white silk cord, one slightly uneven, the rest loose and held by a single bone hairpin. Body: wiry, perched forward with one knee up, a few curled bamboo shavings around her feet. Clothing: the simple graceful silk of an outer disciple: an undyed white robe with two crossed collars, sleeves pushed up at the elbows, a pale ash-grey gauze over-layer, dull silver withered-lotus stitching at the collar, an ash-grey sash tied carelessly. Hands and objects: a dark bamboo flute with six finger-holes held in both hands, fingers lifted and tapping. Power: a faint green glow gathers around her fingers and a few leaf-green motes drift off the flute. Background: tall blurred bamboo stalks scarred by old lightning, soft mist. Light: green-filtered spirit-light from the upper left, a long shaft of pale glow falling through the stalks onto the flute, a soft rim on her hair. Expression: impatient and lazy, cheeky, the sly smile of someone who has just won and is already bored.

people.imagined: He sweeps his forebears' graves in a hamlet on ruined stone. A third broom has just snapped in his hands and he holds the two pieces, calm and a little embarrassed.
people.subject: The moment: standing among old graves with a broken broom, he looks down at the two halves in his hands, steady and quietly puzzled, a little embarrassed that a third broom has snapped. Face, most important: his left sleeve is grey to the elbow with grave dust, in sharp contrast with the clean white right sleeve, and the snapped broom shaft is in his fist. A broad, weathered, open face of twenty-two, tanned, with high cheekbones, thick straight eyebrows, deep-set steady grey eyes and a heavy jaw with a day's stubble. Hair: thick black, worn long and tied back with a single bone hairpin, a few strands dusted grey. Body: a thick-shouldered farmer's build, a little stooped and very still. Clothing: simple, clean mourning silk of an outer disciple: a white robe with two crossed collars and a plain sash, the right sleeve bleached bright, the left gone the colour of ash, a thin black gauze shawl at the shoulders, dull silver withered-lotus stitching along the collar, a few blades of dry grass clinging to the cuff. Hands and objects: both hands hold the two pieces of a bundled-twig broom, dry pale bristles fanned out. Power: a faint damp-green haze low at the elbow and a few grey motes of grave dust floating in the light. Background: low earth graves, a broken old stone wall, thin grass, pale mist. Light: cool pearl spirit-light from the upper left, the sky wide and milky behind him, a soft rim on his cheek. Expression: a calm, a little embarrassed face with lowered eyes on the broken pieces and a soft rueful mouth.

people.imagined: Evening at the graves, at the start of the chant. He opens his mouth and the valley fills, though he does not raise his voice. The zither on his back hums a little by itself.
people.subject: The moment: at the start of the evening chant, he stands with his mouth just opening, face lifted, as a quiet voice swells to fill the valley. Face, most important: a long dark zither strapped diagonally across his back, its end rising behind his shoulder, and a wide, soft-spoken old man's face, clean-shaven. About sixty-five; weathered brown skin with deep lines from nose to mouth; kind, deep-set hooded eyes with heavy lids; white bushy eyebrows; a broad nose; a gentle wide mouth. Hair: thin white, long, gathered in a small knot and crowned with a small dull-silver hair-crown set with a bone pin, a few loose strands. Body: stocky and broad-chested, round shoulders. Clothing: the richest robe of the Pavilion: many layers of yellowed-white mourning silk with three crossed collars and wide trailing sleeves, brocade borders worked in dull silver with withered lotus and incense curls, a translucent black gauze over-robe flowing like smoke, a black band at the cuff, an ash-grey sash with a dark resentment-jade seal; the zither's red-brown cord crosses the chest. Hands: one hand open at his chest, fingers curved as a drummer's would be, fingertips calloused. Power: visible Kết Đan aura, ripples of blue-teal light spreading through the air like water around his mouth, motes rising from the nine pale silk strings. Background: a blurred valley of graves at evening, lamps of spirit-light between the mounds. Light: orange evening glow from the upper left edging his white hair in gold, cool spirit-light in the shadows. Expression: a calm, lifted face with the mouth just opening, deep sad eyes and a quiet reserve behind them.

people.imagined: At the jade beds, dirt to the elbow. She lifts the jade-cutter's lens to look at a green fleck in a stone, three in a hundred years, and thinks the head too patient.
people.subject: The moment: kneeling at a jade bed, she lifts a cutter's lens to her eye and squints at a small green fleck in grey stone, then looks up with a hard impatient stare. Face, most important: a brass-rimmed jade-cutter's lens of rock crystal on a cord held up in one hand, and her forearms black with dirt to the elbow, the nails rimmed with earth. A square-jawed, plain face of about forty; swarthy skin; heavy straight brows; small dark eyes; a wide flat nose; thick lips pressed in a line. Hair: black, a thick braid wound around the head and pinned with a single bone hairpin and a small band of dull silver. Body: broad, square-shouldered, strong, kneeling on a square of pale cloth. Clothing: fine mourning silk of a true disciple: undyed white and ash-grey with three crossed collars, the wide sleeves tied back to the elbow, a black gauze over-robe gathered at her waist, borders embroidered in dull silver with withered lotus and grave-incense curls, an ash-grey sash hung with a dark resentment-jade seal and tassels. Hands: a small green-flecked stone in one palm, the lens in the other. Power: a soft green-teal glow of wood qi sparkles at the stone and a few green motes float around her, steady and contained. Background: dark earth beds and pale jade stones in neat rows, small unlettered stakes, drifting mist. Light: cool pale spirit-light from the upper left, a glowing green rim light from the stone against her jaw. Expression: a hard, resentful stare over the lens with a tight mouth and narrowed eyes.

people.imagined: A copyist at his desk in the draught, left hand writing, right hand cupped over his ear as though to shield it from a wind. The oldest song is still unfinished.
people.subject: The moment: at a desk in lamplight, he writes with his left hand while his right is cupped over his ear, shielding it from a wind that is not there, and squints at the viewer without seeing them clearly. Face, most important: the right hand cupped behind the right ear, and eyes screwed up in a short-sighted squint. A thin, short, sallow face of thirty-five; light brown skin; narrow eyes under drooping lids; thin brows raised; a sharp nose; a mouth slightly open as if listening. Hair: dark, thin, long, parted and combed flat and held by a single bone hairpin, an inky smudge on the forehead. Body: small, thin, shoulders drawn forward. Clothing: fine undyed white and ash-grey mourning silk with three crossed collars, a thick quilted winter lining showing as a padded edge at the neck, a translucent black gauze over-robe, narrow wide-cuffed sleeves with ink on the left cuff, borders embroidered in dull silver with withered lotus and incense curls, an ash-grey sash with a dark resentment-jade seal. Hands and objects: the left hand holds a brush above a blank sheet of pale paper; a small drum of dark wood stands at the edge of the desk; a dozen brushes bound in a rolled cloth at his elbow, handles worn dark. Power: a faint blue-teal ripple spreads in the air near his ear, and a few motes of light drift up from the unwritten page. Background: blurred shelves and a single lamp with a bead of wax running down it. Light: warm lamp glow from the lower left, cool spirit-light behind, a soft silver rim along his reddened ear. Expression: an absorbed, squinting face with brows drawn in concentration and lips slightly parted as he listens.

people.imagined: At the graves in autumn, she sings to a boy who drowned. She has laughed her hoarse brook-water laugh at a memory, and two white hairs have come loose.
people.subject: The moment: standing among graves in autumn, she laughs hoarsely at a private memory, head turned a little to one side. Face, most important: two white hairs stand out against her dark hair at the left temple, left unplucked and catching the light, and her laugh shows her open mouth. A warm, broad face of thirty-two with laugh-lines; brown skin; dark bright eyes; thick straight brows; a rounded nose; a wide smile. Hair: black, long, in a loose low braid over her shoulder with the two white strands visible, held by a single bone hairpin. Body: sturdy, relaxed, a hand-on-hip stance. Clothing: layered mourning silk in undyed white and ash-grey with two crossed collars and wide sleeves in long folds, a translucent black gauze over-robe, dull silver withered-lotus embroidery on the borders, an ash-grey sash with a small dark resentment-jade seal, and one small blue ribbon tied at her wrist, faded to the colour of a washed sky. Hands: she holds two small plain brown clay cups of water, one in each palm, side by side, the water trembling with her laugh, one bright and clear, the other faintly clouded. Power: a faint teal shimmer on the water and a few drops of light rising from the cups. Background: blurred autumn grass and low mounds, two small streams glinting in the mist. Light: warm gold autumn glow from the upper left mixed with cool spirit-light, a soft rim on her hair, warm light in the creases beside her eyes. Expression: a hoarse laugh fading into a soft, sad smile, eyes warm and slightly wet, the head turned aside.

people.imagined: He stands in the cave hall in ridge furs, an unlit lamp at his belt. He is choosing which hunters' child to shut in tonight, and looks at the viewer as at a possible child.
people.subject: The moment: standing in a cave hall, he studies the viewer from under heavy brows as though choosing which hunters' child to shut in tonight. Face, most important: a round unlit cave lamp of dark iron, as big as a melon with a dry white wick, held in one fist at his chest on a greasy cord wrapped twice round it, and a scar through one eyebrow. A short, heavy man of about fifty-five, with tanned leathery skin, thick grey-black eyebrows, small deep-set black eyes, a thick nose with a broken bridge, heavy jowls and a closed unsmiling mouth. Hair: grey-black, long, bound in a topknot with a single bone hairpin, with an iron-grey beard trimmed square. Body: short, thick and powerful. Clothing: a heavy robe of the Cave Hall's keeper: layered ash-grey and white mourning silk with three crossed collars, a broad fur collar kept at the shoulders as his ridge-people's custom, a translucent black gauze over-robe, dull silver withered-lotus borders, a sash with a dark resentment-jade seal and a bone toggle. Hands and objects: gripping the lamp, a faint grey metal gleam on its black iron. Power: a violet-black aura clings to him like cave air, with dark motes drifting from the dead wick. Background: black cave stone behind him, a few bones set in niches, violet-black mist at the edges. Light: dim reddish brazier glow from the lower left with a cold violet spirit-light rim, showing the scar. Expression: stubborn and loyal, flat and cruel, the heavy stare of a man looking at a possible child.

people.imagined: He sways to a planting beat only he can hear. The graves answered his own song back to him, and his village has not forgiven him. He grins anyway, thinking of the next verse.
people.subject: The moment: swaying on his feet to an invisible planting beat, he grins sideways at the viewer as if about to launch into a song, thinking of the next verse. Face, most important: a deeply sunburnt neck and throat, red-brown above a clean white collar, and his head mid-sway, tilted. A long, cheerful, loose-featured face of twenty-two, red-brown and peeling slightly on the nose, with bright hazel eyes, mobile thick brows, a wide uneven grin and a dimple in the chin. Hair: short-to-shoulder brown, sun-streaked, sticking up, held by a single bone hairpin gone askew. Body: tall and loose-limbed, one shoulder dropped. Clothing: the simple graceful silk of an outer disciple: a clean undyed white robe with two crossed collars, the sleeves rolled to the elbow with the ends dark from paddy mud, an ash-grey sash, dull silver withered-lotus stitching at the collar, and a wide yellow rice-straw hat pushed back, its chin cord loose on his chest. Hands: one hand slapping the beat on his thigh, the other held up with fingers spread, the forearms brown and wiry. Power: a faint green glow on the straw hat and a few green motes like rice dust swaying to his beat. Background: blurred green rice shoots at the edge of the graves, soft mist. Light: bright warm spirit-light from the upper left with a luminous rim, hard highlights on the cheekbones and teeth. Expression: cheerful and gregarious, easily distracted, a loose delighted grin from a man whose village has not forgiven his song.

people.imagined: She taps a drum rhythm on her knee without knowing it. She has just been handed the copy room's key and tries not to look at the clerk who lost it.
people.subject: The moment: sitting forward with one hand tapping her knee in a slow rhythm, she holds an iron key on a cord up in the other hand and does not look at the man standing beside her. Face, most important: a crooked fringe cut with her own knife, short on one side and long on the other, over a sharp, narrow face of twenty-three. Pale skin with a few freckles; narrow dark eyes slanted a little upward; thin straight eyebrows; a sharp chin; thin lips pressed in a hidden smile. Hair: black, a straight blunt bob with the uneven fringe, a single bone hairpin behind one ear. Body: thin, sharp-shouldered. Clothing: the simple graceful silk of an outer disciple: undyed white mourning robe with a high close collar over two crossed collars, narrow sleeves with ash-grey gauze cuffs, a grey sash with a small dark jade bead, a small round patch of pale drum-skin stitched with black thread at the left shoulder, dull silver withered-lotus borders. Hands: the right hand on her knee, fingers tapping, the thumbnail bitten; the left holds a long old iron key with a ring bow on a faded red cord. Power: a faint pale-blue shimmer runs along her tapping fingers, tiny motes pulsing to the rhythm. Background: blurred shelves of bound books, a lamp glow behind. Light: cool grey spirit-light from the left, a soft silver rim on her sharp collarbones. Expression: a restless, secretly pleased face with a pressed-down smile and eyes carefully turned away from the clerk.

people.imagined: A fisher girl on the pavilion's hill, wide-eyed and careful, remembering the net that came up with a singing skull in it. She wrings her rough hands.
people.subject: The moment: standing on a hillside in wind, a fisher girl wrings her rough hands and looks wide-eyed at the viewer, trying to be polite after being sent up the hill, remembering the net that came up with a singing skull in it. Face, most important: one dark curl hangs down over her cheek, wet and shining though everything else about her is dry, and her hands are red and cracked from nets, with white lines where the cords have cut. A small, round, earnest face of fifteen, tanned olive, with big dark eyes under wet lashes, thin neat eyebrows, a small snub nose and a shy half-smile. Hair: black, tied in a plain tail with white silk cord and a single small bone hairpin, one curl loose and wet, lifted by the wind so that it clings to the cheek. Body: small and round-shouldered, the wrists thin. Clothing: the plainest clean new silk of an outer disciple, still stiff: an undyed white mourning robe with two crossed collars and sleeves a little too long, hanging over the knuckles, a white sash, a netting cord looped around one wrist, a faint dull silver withered-lotus trim at the collar. Hands: clasped together at the chest. Power: a faint blue-teal sheen on the wet curl and a few glimmering droplets of light floating in the wind. Background: a pale grey sky of drifting mist, a hill, and a thread of river far below, silver in the grey. Light: soft damp spirit-light from the upper left with a gentle glowing rim. Expression: cautious and humble, patient, the polite, anxious attention of a girl who does not yet know what she is wanted for.

people.imagined: He comes out of the grove with a bundle of lightning-struck canes, lopsided from the weight, a flute half bored in his hand. He wants only to be left alone.
people.subject: The moment: standing in a bamboo grove with a bundle of dark canes over one shoulder, leaning to one side under the weight, he looks at the viewer with calm reserve; he wants only to be left alone. Face, most important: a lopsided posture, one shoulder high and the other low, and rows of small pale crescent bore-nicks across both thumbs. A long, patient, quiet face of twenty-eight, olive, with heavy-lidded brown eyes, straight eyebrows, a long straight nose and a closed mouth. Hair: black, long, tied in a topknot with a green cord and a single bone hairpin. Body: lanky, one shoulder pulled up by habit, a leather pad on the shoulder under the canes. Clothing: simple, clean mourning silk in undyed white with a close collar over two crossed collars, narrow sleeves, an ash-grey sash, a thin black gauze scarf, dull silver withered-lotus stitching at the collar, sandals laced with green bamboo bark. Hands and objects: four canes as thick as a wrist, scorched black in zigzag lines where lightning struck them, tied with straw rope on his shoulder; in one hand a half-bored flute of dark bamboo with four finger-holes. Power: a faint green wood-qi mist clings to the canes and a few pale green motes drift between the stalks. Background: tall blurred bamboo scarred black by lightning, a faint green mist. Light: green-filtered spirit-light from the upper left, a soft rim along his jaw. Expression: a closed, calm, reserved face with steady eyes and a still mouth that asks for nothing.

people.imagined: A foundling boy, humming a tune nobody taught him. He sits with a straw cape around his shoulders, trusting, in morning light.
people.subject: The moment: a small boy sits wrapped in a straw cape at morning, humming quietly with his eyes half closed, content and trusting. Face, most important: his two eyes are different colours, the left grey and the right brown, both clearly visible. A round, soft face of twelve; fair skin with rosy cheeks; fine light brows; a small button nose; a little open mouth humming. Hair: soft brown, tousled from sleep, a halo of pink mist-light around it. Body: small, relaxed, sitting, with a very small pair of knees showing. Clothing: a clean child's robe of soft undyed white silk with a round neck and two thin crossed collars, a white silk cord at the waist, a tiny hint of dull silver withered-lotus stitching at the hem, and over it a stiff overlapping straw rain cape of a river guide's kind, pale gold, too big for him and drooping at the shoulders, tied at the neck with a twist of grass. Hands: resting in his lap, small clean nails, one finger tapping softly. Power: a faint teal glimmer drifts in the mist around him, a few soft motes like dew rising from the straw. Background: pale dawn mist over old graves, the faint shapes of low mounds. Light: soft pink morning spirit-light from the upper left, gentle glowing rim light on his cheek and hair. Expression: half-closed eyes and a soft, trusting smile with lips humming, the small face relaxed.

people.imagined: A memorial portrait of the first elder at the age she went into the deepest grave to renew the ward: grave and brave, with a small tender smile for the sister she leaves outside.
people.subject: The moment: a memorial portrait, faded as on old silk, of a woman about to go down into a grave to renew a ward, looking out at the viewer with calm resolve and a tender, brief smile. Face, most important: a broad forehead with one vertical line between the brows, and her two palms pressed together in front of her chest as for a vow. A kind, firm, oval face of about forty-five; warm brown skin; dark steady eyes with softly crinkled corners; strong straight brows; a straight nose; a full mouth. Hair: black with one streak of white at the front, long, pinned in a high coil with a single bone hairpin and a small silver crown. Body: tall, straight, calm. Clothing: the richest robe of the Pavilion's elders: layered undyed white and ash-grey mourning silk with three crossed collars and wide flowing sleeves, a translucent black gauze over-robe like smoke, brocade borders embroidered in dull silver with withered lotus and grave-incense curls, black bands at the cuffs, an ash-grey sash hung with a dark resentment-jade seal and a small bronze bell charm the size of a bean. Hands: her pressed palms are long-fingered and unringed, with a faint pale line along each thumb. Power: a visible aura of an elder, a faint teal wash of light and soft motes rising around her like a halo. Background: the dim stone mouth of a grave, a dim arch with a few faded green marks on the lintel, a faded teal mist. Light: soft pale glow from the upper left, as from an old lamp; the whole picture slightly faded, soft-edged and yellowed like old silk, crackled like old glaze. Expression: a grave, resolute face with steady eyes and a small tender smile, faded like old silk.
